baselinePrompt:
Covered outdoor walkway of an upscale shopping complex, evening. Warm amber light spills from gold wall sconces and illuminated storefronts, casting a rich, honeyed glow across beige stone columns and a dark paved floor. Ordinary foot traffic moves past in all directions — shoppers, families, couples — incidental and unhurried.

[INFLUENCER] is dressed in a fitted black crew-neck t-shirt, dark navy/black jogger-style trousers, and clean white sneakers. He wears gold-frame rectangular aviator-style sunglasses and a metal-bracelet watch on his wrist. He walks steadily toward camera through the foot traffic, phone held loosely at his side.

**Hook — first seconds:** Camera sits at a medium full-body distance, slightly elevated, shooting down the walkway toward [INFLUENCER] as he approaches. His right arm rises, lifting one hand up toward his head — both hands come up together, fingers raking back over his head in a casual, confident gesture as he continues walking forward, chin slightly down, sunglasses on, eyes scanning downward with a relaxed, unbothered expression.

He holds both hands up at the crown of his head for a beat, still walking toward camera, then lets them drop back to his sides naturally as he continues his stride.

**Mid-clip:** The camera slowly closes the distance or the subject advances until he fills more of the frame. He raises one hand to the side of his aviators and adjusts the frame with two fingers — a slow, deliberate touch — then lets his hand fall. He walks past camera. Foot traffic flows naturally around him; incidental passersby continue their own routines.

**Final section:** Camera cuts to a tighter angle, now behind and slightly to the side. [INFLUENCER] moves through the walkway, hand briefly lifting again to touch the sunglasses frame once more, then lowering. He continues walking forward and out of frame. The warm amber-lit stone corridor and ordinary shoppers fill the background throughout.

Lighting: warm, slightly underexposed ambient evening light with practical sconce and storefront glow. No harsh flash. Shallow depth of field keeps background figures soft. Overall tone is candid, unhurried, real-life pace.
